development_type: Other relevant demolition in conservation area
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  (Existing Plans SE303/01, SE303/02, SE303/03, SE303/07, SE303/04, SE303/05, SE303/06, SE303/07 Received 21 October 2009.Amended Plans SE303/08 (Rev A), SE303/09 (Rev A) SE303/10 (Rev C), SE 303/11(Rev B), SE 303/12 (Rev C), SE 303/13 (Rev B), SE 303/14 (Rev B) Received 23 March 2010.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - All new external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.  No work shall be carried out until further details of the materials to be used have been submitted and approved by the Council.   This shall include the brickwork (including mortar and profiles of coping), profiles of the stone coping, windows and doors.  The details so approved shall be carried out as part of the development.
description: Conservation Area Consent for the demolition of part of boundary wall.
